title: Implement a recursive descent arithmetic expression evaluator in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement a tokenizer and recursive descent parser/evaluator for arithmetic expressions supporting +, -, *, / with proper precedence, parentheses, unary minus, and integer/float literals.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement evaluate(expr: str) -> float in src/evaluator.py using recursive descent.

Grammar:
  expr   -> term (('+' | '-') term)*
  term   -> factor (('*' | '/') factor)*
  factor -> '-' factor | '(' expr ')' | NUMBER

Implementation sketch:

def tokenize(expr: str) -> list[str]:
    # Split into number tokens and operator/paren tokens.
    # Use re.findall(r'\d+\.?\d*|[+\-*/()]', expr)

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens): self.tokens = tokens; self.pos = 0
    def peek(self): return self.tokens[self.pos] if self.pos < len(self.tokens) else None
    def consume(self): t = self.tokens[self.pos]; self.pos += 1; return t
    def parse_expr(self):   # handles + and -
    def parse_term(self):   # handles * and /
    def parse_factor(self): # handles unary minus, parens, numbers

def evaluate(expr: str) -> float:
    tokens = tokenize(expr)
    return Parser(tokens).parse_expr()

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: tokenize splits expression into number and operator tokens
parse_term handles * and / with correct precedence over +/-
parse_factor handles unary minus and parenthesized sub-expressions
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (5 tests)
uv run python -c "from src.evaluator import evaluate" passes

Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
